remaining.summary: Hardware acceleration performance was measured in Chrome on Apple Metal. The browser's local WASM path was verified separately.

resolution.summary: Confirmed the live PoCut authorization request asks only for openid and Legitate renders it checked, disabled, and required for this connection. Existing hosted callback tests reject missing identity. Deployed DBS-TIGER hardware WebGPU with the repo-pinned corrected ORT build and per-job fixed time dimension. Chrome/Metal production E2E created aligned stems and persisted them across reload within 24s for the 3.8s stereo fixture (previous production observation ~44s). Equivalent graph timings including init were 20.7s GPU vs 38.7s WASM and relative spectral RMS <0.001% at 328 and 517 frames. The deployed worker plus browser host adapter passed tests with WebGPU absent and with the WebGPU runtime request deliberately failing; both produced the same local 48 kHz stereo WAVs. Legacy hosted inference endpoints still return 404.
